The screaming man eventually calmed down and is reportedly attending city council meetings complaining the sun is too bright. Both the suspect's vehicle and the victim's vehicle were towed from the scene. The suspect, identified as DeAndre Bradshaw, was charged with fleeing or eluding an officer causing bodily harm or property damage. Two counts of first degree recklessly endangering safety, hit and run, resisting or obstructing an officer, possession of THC, and seven counts of felony bail jump, According to court records, D'Andre was found guilty of fleeing or eluding an officer causing bodily harm or property damage and two counts of felony bail jumping jumping, following no contest pleas. Additional charges were dismissed, but read in as part of a plea agreement. DeAndre was sentenced to five years of prison and five years of extended supervision. The felony bail jumping sentences run concurrently, and he received 353 days of credit for time served. He will be released back into the public in 2028 when he is 37 years old.
